create_SpotQRDetector: create a SpotQRDetector instance with a Spot robot and list of camera IDs for QR code detection
initialize_april_tag_detectors: initialize April tag detectors for all requested cameras using camera intrinsics and output dictionary
get_avg_spotWorld_T_marker: get the average transformation from Spot world frame to QR marker by collecting multiple detections
get_camera1_T_camera2: get the instantaneous transform between two cameras by detecting a shared QR marker in both views
run_SpotQRDetector_main: run the SpotQRDetector module to compute average marker pose and inter-camera transform on a Spot robot
